facts: Saphyr concrete f32/f64 takes the effective scalar text, parses YAML .nan/.inf spellings into nonfinite native values, then visits that concrete float. Finite fallback rejects overflowing numeric literals. Typeless rejection is therefore not a concrete bespoke finite invariant; actual type Deserialize remains necessary. Single-document enforcement occurs after the scoped callback, independent from numeric contracts.

P16 placement resolve caches first matching Grip ID/role width before applying facing to a cloned recipe, then copies that width into every ResolvedComponent while component offsets/rotations are materialized. This is additional exact-variant support for pending OBS002 first-width versus later frame registration; multiple-Grip admission and receiving guard semantics still require proof. Repeated Pommel profile scaling is materialization on a cloned recipe in this path, not source recipe mutation.
